patent.title: 电池包、车辆和储能装置
patent.family_note: Package C non-life-science complex product portfolio anchor. Member of BYD’s 2019-01-09 priority / 2019-06-21 same-day CTP and long-cell filing wave (Google Patents family tree lists 40+ related CN filings). Complementary siblings include CN110165115B (V1/V2≥55% utilization) and CN110165118B (Issue #2 cold-start sibling). Secondary media often cite this grant when narrating Blade Battery, but official exact-patent → product mapping remains unpublished.

knowledge_origin.description: Public patent grant identifies BYD inventorship/ownership of a long-cell CTP pack architecture later commercialized under the Blade Battery product platform narrative.

technology.problem: Module-based EV packs waste volume and add mass through module frames plus pack beams, limiting energy density and increasing assembly complexity.
technology.mechanism: Long cells (600–2500 mm first size) are arrayed and supported on pack support members / side beams so cells themselves contribute structural stiffness, enabling reduced or eliminated internal beams and higher pack space utilization (CTP-style architecture).
technology.comparison_baseline: Module + end/side plate packs with pack cross/longitudinal beams; patent family texts contrast ~40% volume utilization versus claimed ≥55–60%+ CTP utilization.

value_carriers.name: 比亚迪刀片电池 CTP 专利簇（同日/同优先权长单体与电池包族）
value_carriers.description: CN110165116B is a bibliographic member of BYD’s large same-priority CTP/cell filing wave; complementary siblings cover pack structure and volume-utilization thresholds. This confirms portfolio membership, not single-patent product implementation.

value_carriers.name: 刀片电池 / Blade Battery（CTP 产品平台）
value_carriers.description: Official BYD disclosures establish Blade Battery as a CTP product platform with multi-vehicle fitment. Public sources reviewed do not officially map CN110165116B individually to Blade Battery BOMs; secondary IP media often cite it, which is recorded as E3/unknown rather than confirmed exact mapping.

value_carriers.name: 比亚迪汉 EV / Han EV（刀片电池装车载体）
value_carriers.description: Official launch materials state Han EV would be equipped with Blade Battery. That is platform→vehicle fitment evidence, not CN110165116B→Han exact-patent mapping.

value_links.note: Confirms multi-patent product-stack membership. Does not establish which sibling is practiced in which vehicle. Relation typed as other (= portfolio membership); schema 1.0 has no member_of enum.
Blade platform success is public; exact CN110165116B implementation remains unknown. Media >300-patent framing forbids single-patent inheritance.
Han EV uses Blade Battery at product level; no public exact-patent map to CN110165116B.

value_metrics.period: early-2020 media report of executive statement
value_metrics.note: Program/platform-scope narrative metric only. Must not be inherited as CN110165116B value. Not an audited census.
Complementary sibling claim theme illustrating multi-claim-set product architecture. Not a measured Han EV pack metric attributable to CN110165116B.

gaps.description: Official BYD disclosures establish Blade Battery → Han/Tang/Atto 3 platform fitment, and bibliographic sources place CN110165116B in the CTP patent cluster, but no public regulated disclosure maps CN110165116B individually to a named vehicle BOM or pack SKU. Secondary media citation of 116 is not treated as confirmed exact mapping.
needed_evidence: Claim chart from this grant to a shipped Blade pack

gaps.description: Blade commercial success and media '>300 patents' framing are portfolio/product-system facts. No public apportionment assigns safety, range, cost, or revenue increments to CN110165116B versus siblings (115/118/cell patents) or later continuations.
needed_evidence: Counterfactual if this grant alone were removed from the CTP cluster

gaps.description: V0.7 can honestly stop at R0 for one CTP grant inside a commercially successful auto battery stack, but cannot represent the product-system object: complementary claim sets (structure vs utilization), sibling mis-mapping risk, cell-layer vs pack-layer patents, multi-vehicle platform edges, or portfolio-size narrative independent of any one grant.
needed_evidence: platform→vehicle edges separate from patent→platform edges

notes: Package C non-life-science complex product portfolio replication (auto / CTP battery stack). Standalone V0.7 analysis intentionally stops at R0 for CN110165116B even though Blade Battery and Han EV are commercially successful: portfolio membership and product-platform facts are public, but exact-patent mapping and patent-level attributable value are not. Complements CRISPR (life-science multi-portfolio license network) and AVC SEP/pool with a same-assignee multi-patent product-system stack. Distinct from Issue #2 cold-start on sibling CN110165118B. evidence_levels_present corrected to [E1,E2]: E-BYD-BLADE-116-SECONDARY-CITATION is status=unknown (sought-but-not-found); unknown-E3 ≠ present (PR #32 friction fix).
